Suite A, Midvale, UT Menu ABOUT US Why 5 Star Kitchen & Bath? __________ At 5 Star Kitchen & Bath, we believe remodeling should feel exciting — not overwhelming. As a trusted kitchen and bathroom remodeling company serving Salt Lake City and surrounding Utah communities, our focus is simple: deliver high-quality craftsmanship, durable materials, and a streamlined experience from consultation to completion. We specialize in custom kitchen remodeling and bathroom renovations designed to enhance both beauty and long-term home value. Every project is approached with precision, transparency, and a commitment to doing the job right the first time. As part of a national dealer network with over 200 locations across North America, we combine the strength of proven systems and trusted products with the personal attention of a local Utah remodeling team. That means you benefit from innovative, maintenance-friendly materials and industry-leading standards — without sacrificing personalized service. Our team stays ahead of remodeling trends, contemporary design advancements, and eco-conscious building practices to ensure your project is both modern and sustainable. We believe homeowners deserve remodeling solutions that are attractive, durable, and built to last. Above all, we operate with integrity. We stand behind our work, honor our commitments, and treat every home as if it were our own. If you’re ready to transform your kitchen or bathroom in Salt Lake City, we invite you to schedule a free in-home design consultation and experience the 5 Star difference. you've always wanted. Our Mission & Values Our Mission Our mission is to elevate kitchen and bathroom remodeling in Utah by delivering innovative, durable, and beautifully designed spaces that improve everyday living. We aim to simplify the remodeling process while providing cost-effective solutions that homeowners can trust. We are committed to craftsmanship, clear communication, and results that enhance both lifestyle and property value. Our Core Values Integrity First We conduct business with honor, transparency, and accountability. Our customers trust us with their homes — and we take that responsibility seriously. Customer-Centered Service Every remodeling project begins with listening. We tailor our designs, materials, and timelines around your needs, budget, and vision. Quality Without Compromise We use high-quality, low-maintenance materials designed for durability and long-term performance. Innovation & Sustainability We stay current with remodeling trends and eco-conscious building practices to provide modern, efficient solutions that reduce maintenance and environmental impact. Professional Excellence From your first consultation to final installation, our team maintains clear communication, organized project management, and dependable follow-through. No Pressure. why_choose_our_walk_in_tubs.title: Why Choose Our Walk In Tubs
why_choose_our_walk_in_tubs.text: Why Choose Our Walk In Tubs Skip to main content 801-999-4548 support@5starkb.com 6951 S. 300 W. Suite A, Midvale, UT Menu Why Choose Our Walk-In Bathtubs? We offers a wide variety of high-quality Acrylic walk in bathtubs with over 900 SKU’s and 20+ models. Ranging from various shapes, styles and sizes, you can customize your packaging and jetting options as well, giving you the perfect tub to fit your criteria. Our walk-in tubs and accessories are created using the highest standard of craftsmanship. Acrylic VS Gelcoat. Our acrylic tubs are formed from a solid sheet of material providing you with a consistent and quality product every time. They have a brilliant nonporous finish that is impermeable to mold and mildew, long lasting, and easy to maintain. Acrylics non-porous surface ensures that mold and mildew cannot seep into the material and build up over time causing several issues. Whereas get coat tubs are created using several layers of gel coat which causes a rougher porous surface that is susceptible to mold and mildew. Our acrylic tubs are reinforced with fiberglass and are supported by a rustproof solid stainless steel frame with adjustable leveling legs, giving you a safe, sturdy, and long-lasting walk-in bathtub. Gravity Driven 2” Dual Drain Technology vs single electrical 1 ½” drains by competitors. Our Walk-In Tubs feature unique Dual Drain Technology (DDT) which consists of two (2) independently operated 2” gravity driven drains. Each drain is outfitted with its own overflow and stainless-steel cable operated drain opener with extended handle for an easier grip. Typical drainage time is approximately +/-80 seconds at ideal in-home plumbing conditions. Having two gravity driven 2” drains not only provides you with quick and reliable drainage, but also acts as a safety feature in case if one drain fails, allowing you to safely drain and exit the walk-in tub. The two-inch drains can be connected using Tee or Y 2” pipe connectors to the standard 1 ½” or 2” house drain. If possible, it is recommended to connect into 2” or 3” house drain for a faster drainage time. Our gravity driven Dual Drain drains are fast and reliable because they do not require electric pump. Whereas electrical driven drains may fail due to electrical shorts or power outages. Unique exclusive designs for maximum interior space, comfort, and seat width. Our Walk In Tubs range from a wide variety of sizes and styles all while keeping in mind the bathers comfort. Our designs provide more space than our competition and wider seats for your comfort. Multiple cleansing mechanisms to ensure the cleanliness and longevity of your walk-in bathtub. Our Walk-In Tubs Hydro and Air systems all include cleansing systems that you don’t need to think twice about. No need to press extra buttons or worry about forgetting to engage the Ozone Sterilization or the Autopurge. Both systems engage automatically so that you can have a stress-free and worry-free bathing experience. Hydro systems all come equipped with chemical free Ozone Sterilization that engages when the hydro jets are turned on. Air systems all include autopurge which will engage automatically after you’ve finished bathing to expel any excess water and/or debris that may have entered the lines. Both systems help to prevent mold and mildew build up so that you don’t need to worry about it. Select models offer independent foot massage, enjoy a foot massage without having to fully bathe. Our Ultimate and Big4Two offer an exclusive independent foot massage system. The days of needs to fill the entire bath tub just for a foot massage are long gone. With these unique systems, one just needs to fill the lower portion of the tubs to enjoy a foot massage! Strategically placed jetting to maximize therapeutic effects. Here at 5 Star Kitchen and Bath we pride ourselves on properly placed jetting to ensure maximum therapeutic relief. Our jetting systems are designed with one thing in mind: you. Hydro systems are made to target area’s our competitors typically don’t pay attention too, such as your thighs and hips, as well as angled foot jets so that you can sit in a relaxed position and not have to hold your foot up to a jet on a flat wall. Air jet systems are typically positioned in a similar fashion making sure to get that gentle massage to your hips, thighs, and lower back. Wide variety of optional equipment, fixtures, and accessories. From heated seats and backrests to our unique 4-fold bath screen and everything in between, 5 Star Kitchen and Bath offers an incredible amount of options so that you can customize your tub to be ideal for you. Unique designs and fixtures. There are some features that only our Walk-In Tubs offers. These include the Removable Stainless Steel Door with Tempered Glass on our inward swing tub line, the Patented 360° Swivel Tray, the Thermostatic Control Valve, and Dual Drain Technology. The Removable Stainless-Steel Door with Tempered Glass is a sleek, modern door that can be detached from the walk-in bathtub. This allows you to be able to clean hard to reach places much more easily. The Patented 360° Swivel Tray is a tray that can easily be rotated so as to not make it difficult to enter of exit the walk in bathtub. It can hold your bathroom essentials such as a nice glass of wine or a good book and it doesn’t get in your way thanks to its rotating capabilities. The 360° Swivel Tray is available on the Elite, Petite, Royal, and Ultimate models. Our Walk In Bathtubs stand out from the competition because we add such unique features. Easy installation. Hassle free ordering process. No nonsense ordering process. Our customer service reps will answer any questions you may have and assist you in selecting the right tub with the right equipment based on your needs. Created, jetted, assembled, and tested in Chicago, IL using NuWhirl UL certified parts, a California Company. Our Walk-In Tubs are jetted and assembled in Chicago. Every tub is thoroughly tested in our facility before being shipped out. We test everything from fixtures to the installation of the tub. Tubs are filled and tested for leaks, drains are tested, everything is tested and inspected from head to toe before we ship anything to our customers. Next day shipping on standard package tubs, 48 hour shipping on majority custom orders Excellent customer service and technical support A+ BBB Accredited Business Back to Walk In Tubs No Pressure. No Guesswork. Just Clear Answers.
